title: Bundesliga 2025/26: most goals
brief: Name the ten clubs that scored the most Bundesliga goals in 2025/26.

notes.Augsburg: Augsburg and Wolfsburg both scored 45, joint 10th.
notes.Wolfsburg: Wolfsburg and Augsburg both scored 45, joint 10th.
notes.Mainz: Mainz scored 44, just outside (joint 12th with Union Berlin).
notes.Union Berlin: Union Berlin scored 44, just outside (joint 12th with Mainz).

checks: Goals for in Wikipedia's final table match the table worked out from every 2025/26 result at football-data.co.uk, and Transfermarkt's table. Koln are 9th with 49; Augsburg and Wolfsburg tie on 45 for 10th, so they share the place as a pool.
